description.value: This awe striking, almost alien trip, draws us into the otherworldly watery realm of cephalopods --- except they aren't alien.  Octopuses (not octopi, as the author informs) may arguably be as intelligent, as highly curious, and absolutely more dexterous than human beings.  Sy Montgomery introduces us to these creatures with their fascinating and individual personalities.

subjects: SCIENCE / Life Sciences / Biology / Marine Biology
title: The Soul of an Octopus
